finding: The bounded implementation retains material and stable released shapes; each permitted settling transfer lowers a nonnegative integer potential.
limitations: The finite-rest argument applies after imposed tool work stops; it gives no useful universal real-time performance bound.
Fixed packing and coarse columns omit overhangs, underground cavities, grain contact and momentum.
The scoop is an unlimited bookkeeping account, not a physical bucket.
Browser mobile checks were emulation, not physical-device testing; no new experiment was run for this release.
method: Integer aggregate columns, an explicit scoop account, deterministic local transfers and a decreasing potential after tool work stops.
open_questions: How would a different neighborhood or representation change the resting shape and work needed to reach it?
